name: cpsrf-srf-v4-backend
description: CPSRF/SRF V4 backend - Phase 1: auth, MFA, RBAC, audit logging, security foundation

notes.crypto_dependencies: Password hashing (scrypt), TOTP (RFC 6238), and JWT (HS256) are implemented in src/security/crypto/ using ONLY Node.js built-in modules (node:crypto) with zero external dependencies. This was a deliberate choice: it lets the auth/MFA/token core run and be unit-tested without any package install, and it removes several third-party packages from the trust boundary around credential handling. They are drop-in replaceable with argon2/otplib/jsonwebtoken if your team prefers audited libraries with wider community usage - see docs/PHASE1_HANDOFF.md.
